args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted.
Flagged (3), all for summary_outlier:
- r07: centre REGR peak 53.09 %/h against a batch median of 0.37. Growth zone 695 µm against 52.5. Largest flank difference -8.36 %/h against 0.55. The profile has a different shape, so this isn't just a faster root.
- r01, r08: the largest flank difference is at 84 µm against a median of 331.5 µm (z -10.77), and its sign is reversed (-0.47 vs 0.55 %/h). The REGR peak is about twice the batch value (0.72 %/h).
Cleared (5): r02, r03, r04, r05, r06. All checks pass with wide margin, and every summary has |z| ≤ 1.32. r05 took 4 steps but ended on default settings with no remedies kept and no roll-backs.
What the flagged runs share: every final check passed, and none kept a remedy, rolled back or used the width-free ratio. Each was flagged only for a strain-rate or curvature profile shaped unlike the rest of the batch. The kinematic checks did not catch this.
Note: some runs have identical checks and summaries: r01 = r08, r03 = r04, and r02 = r05 = r06. Confirm that these are separate roots or time windows and not duplicate entries.
